issues.issue: Was the Officer required to ask the applicant to update his H&C application?
issues.applicant_position: Officer should have given him a chance to update his H&C application; failing to do so breached natural justice.
issues.result_quote: There is little merit in this argument

issues.issue: Do the Officer's inadequate reasons on establishment in Canada justify setting aside the decision?
issues.applicant_position: Officer's reasons did not explain the evidence relied on to reject his establishment; inadequate reasons warrant setting aside.
issues.respondent_position: Respondent's counsel acknowledges establishment was the main reason for rejection.
issues.result_quote: I am satisfied that the Officer’s decision meets the exigencies of reasonableness and falls within a range of possible, acceptable outcomes
